title: External accounts
description: Connect and manage the Slack and Discord identities recognized as your Azents account.

providerCard.title: Connect an account
providerCard.description: Authorize each external service separately. Connecting an identity does not grant access to any Workspace or conversation.

providerGuidance.not_configured: {provider} account connection has not been configured by an administrator.
providerGuidance.incomplete: {provider} account connection setup is incomplete. Ask an administrator to finish the configuration.
providerGuidance.invalid: {provider} account connection needs administrator attention before it can be used.
providerGuidance.ready: Connect a {provider} identity that you own.
providerGuidance.unavailable: {provider} account connection is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or contact an administrator.

emptyDescription: Use an available Connect action above to authorize a Slack or Discord identity.
elevationDisconnect: Verify your identity to disconnect {account} from your Azents account.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect external account?
disconnectDialog.description: Disconnect {account} from your Azents account everywhere.
disconnectDialog.impact: Future controls that rely on this linked identity will stop working. Existing guest access, messages, history, shared settings, grants, and blocks are preserved.

errors.provider_unavailable: This external service is not currently available for account connection.
errors.invalid_attempt: This account connection is invalid or must be restarted.
errors.expired: This account connection has expired. Start again.
errors.already_consumed: This account connection has already been completed or can no longer be used.
errors.auth_session_mismatch: Sign in again and restart account connection.
errors.provider_mismatch: This account connection belongs to another external service.
errors.invalid_callback: The external service callback does not match this account connection.
errors.configuration_changed: The external service configuration changed. Start account connection again.
errors.provider_rejected: The external service could not verify this account. Start again.
errors.resource_not_found: This connected account no longer exists or is not available to your account.
errors.conflict: This external identity cannot be connected to your account.
errors.unavailable: This connected identity is no longer available. Reload and try again.
errors.busy: Account linking is temporarily busy. Try again.

oauthResult.connectedDescription: {account} is now recognized as your Azents account when this {provider} identity is used.
oauthResult.cancelledDescription: No account was connected. You can restart {provider} authorization when ready.
oauthResult.authRequiredDescription: Sign in to Azents and restart account connection from External accounts.

failure.elevation_required: Verify your identity and restart account connection.
failure.provider_unavailable: This external service is not currently available. Return to External accounts to review its status.
failure.invalid_attempt: This account connection is invalid. Start a new connection from External accounts.
failure.expired: This account connection expired. Start a new connection from External accounts.
failure.already_consumed: This account connection has already completed or can no longer be used.
failure.auth_session_mismatch: Your Azents sign-in session changed. Sign in again and start a new connection.
failure.provider_mismatch: This callback belongs to another external service. Start the intended connection again.
failure.configuration_changed: The external service configuration changed while you were connecting. Start again with the current configuration.
failure.provider_rejected: The external service could not verify this account. Review the provider authorization and try again.
failure.resource_not_found: This account connection is no longer available. Start again.
failure.conflict: This external identity cannot be connected. No existing owner information was disclosed.
failure.unavailable: This account connection is no longer available. Start again.
failure.busy: Account linking is temporarily busy. Try again.
failure.invalid_provider: This external service is not supported for account connection. Return to External accounts.
failure.invalid_callback: The callback is incomplete or invalid. Start a new connection from External accounts.
